skills.name: docmap
skills.summary: Recursive, indexed documentation. Every folder gets a generated `INDEX.md` (what is here, when to read it); the CLI searches, outlines and extracts single sections so an agent never reads a whole doc blind. Numbered decisions and learnings with templates; `init` scaffolds a new project.
skills.triggers: Reading, searching or adding project docs; recording a decision or a learning

skills.name: backlog
skills.summary: File-based issue tracker for agents ("Linear in a folder"). Markdown issues with priority, status, dependencies and a log; a CLI with `next --claim`, `start`, `log`, `block`, `done`, `board`, `check`, `retro`. Built for long autonomous loops. With docmap installed it surfaces related decisions and learnings at claim time and files new ones at close time.
skills.triggers: Planning work, "what's next", creating/closing issues, status reports, autonomous runs, retros

skills.name: design
skills.summary: Design system in files. W3C DTCG tokens are the single source; `build` generates CSS (optionally a Tailwind v4 `@theme`), a typed TS export and a one-line-per-token `TOKENS.md`; a 150-line `DESIGN.md` is the agent entry point, with component specs, surface targets (wallet pass, email, print, OG) and reference intake notes. `check` covers references, WCAG contrast per theme, stale outputs and hard-coded values in source.
skills.triggers: Building or changing UI, email, print, passes or OG images; turning a brand book, screenshots or CSS into tokens; adding colors, fonts or components

skills.name: whatsapp
skills.summary: Read, search and send WhatsApp messages from your own account through [`wacli`](https://github.com/openclaw/wacli) (linked device + local SQLite mirror). Read-only by default; every send needs an explicit request, a resolved recipient and a confirmed draft. Can also set it up: installs `wacli` 0.26+, pairs it by phone code (you type the code on your phone) and installs the sync service, asking before each step.
skills.triggers: Checking, summarizing, finding or answering WhatsApp messages; sending a WhatsApp text or file; setting up wacli

skills.name: crew
skills.summary: Builds one feature with an agent team on top of `backlog`: the orchestrator plans, a fast model implements each child, a capable model advises on hard decisions (fixed triggers), and a model from another provider critiques the plan and reviews each diff. `crew.json` maps roles to seats (provider + model, or a tier); a seat the harness cannot reach falls back and is logged. You approve the plan and merge. References for T3, Claude Code and Codex.
skills.triggers: Building a feature "with crew" or "with the team"; planning and implementing an epic with cross-provider review
